nodes.description: Private mapping(address => uint256) tracking token balances of every account.
Private nested mapping of owner => spender => allowance.
Private uint256 holding the total token supply.
Private string storing the ERC20 token name.
Private string storing the ERC20 token symbol.
Internal _transfer(sender, recipient, amount) that moves balances and emits Transfer.
Internal _mint(account, amount) that increases total supply and credits a balance.
Internal _burn(account, amount) that debits a balance and decreases total supply.
Public transfer(recipient, amount) forwarding to _transfer from _msgSender().
Public transferFrom(sender, recipient, amount) that checks and decrements allowance.
Public approve(spender, amount) setting allowance for _msgSender().
Public increaseAllowance(spender, addedValue) adding to the current allowance.
Public decreaseAllowance(spender, subtractedValue) removing from the current allowance.
Internal _approve(owner, spender, amount) writing the allowance mapping.
Public burn(amount) destroying tokens from _msgSender() via _burn.
Public burnFrom(account, amount) checking allowance then burning.
ERC20PresetFixedSupply constructor minting initialSupply to owner.
Context._msgSender() returning msg.sender.
msg.sender, caller-controlled address used as the transaction initiator.
Unchecked balance decrement senderBalance - amount and credit _balances[recipient] += amount inside _transfer.
_totalSupply += amount and _balances[account] += amount arithmetic inside _mint.
Unchecked _balances[account] = accountBalance - amount and _totalSupply -= amount inside _burn.
Unchecked allowance subtraction currentAllowance - amount in transferFrom and burnFrom.
uint256 amount passed to transfer/_transfer/_mint/_burn/approve functions.
address recipient destination of a token transfer.
address sender source of a token transfer.
address spender granted or revoked an allowance.
uint256 initialSupply minted by the preset constructor.
address owner receiving the preminted initial supply.
address account credited or debited in _mint/_burn/burnFrom.
uint256 senderBalance snapshot read from _balances in _transfer.
uint256 currentAllowance snapshot of the spender allowance.
uint256 accountBalance snapshot read from _balances in _burn.

edges.reason: _msgSender() returns msg.sender directly.
transfer uses _msgSender() as the from address.
transferFrom uses _msgSender() as the spender for allowance checks.
approve assigns allowance to _msgSender().
increaseAllowance reads and writes the caller allowance.
decreaseAllowance reads and writes the caller allowance.
burn destroys tokens from _msgSender().
burnFrom uses _msgSender() as the spender.
transfer calls internal _transfer.
transferFrom calls internal _transfer.
transferFrom calls _approve to reduce the allowance.
approve calls _approve.
increaseAllowance calls _approve with the new amount.
decreaseAllowance calls _approve with the reduced amount.
burn calls internal _burn.
burnFrom calls internal _burn.
burnFrom calls _approve to reduce the allowance.
constructor calls _mint for the preminted supply.
_transfer writes the _balances mapping for sender and recipient.
_mint credits _balances[account].
_mint increases _totalSupply.
_burn debits _balances[account].
_burn decreases _totalSupply.
_approve writes the _allowances mapping.
_transfer performs unchecked balance subtraction and unchecked balance addition.
amount is the operand of the unchecked balance arithmetic.
senderBalance is the minuend of the unchecked subtraction.
_mint adds amount to total supply and balance.
amount is added into _totalSupply and _balances.
_burn performs unchecked balance subtraction and supply subtraction.
amount is the operand of the burn arithmetic.
accountBalance is the minuend of the unchecked subtraction.
transferFrom subtracts amount from currentAllowance inside unchecked block.
burnFrom subtracts amount from currentAllowance inside unchecked block.
currentAllowance is the minuend of the unchecked allowance subtraction.
amount is the subtrahend of the unchecked allowance subtraction.
msg.sender ultimately supplies the sender address to _transfer.
owner address at construction is externally supplied and forwarded into _mint.
